$comment: The acceptance gate fails on any compact-health problem that is NOT listed here.
An entry means: this degradation is known, has an owner record, and must not page.
It does NOT mean the problem is acceptable forever -- expiresAt forces a re-review,
and the gate fails outright once that date passes.
Entries are matched on name:status exactly. A source that recovers is reported as
'recovered' on the next run (prune it); a source that fails with a DIFFERENT status
than the one baselined is treated as new and blocks, which is the point.
chinaCoverage and shippingRates are in api/health.js ON_DEMAND_KEYS. Once the
onDemand marker added alongside this file reaches production, they are exempted at
source level and these two entries become redundant -- they are listed only to cover
the window before that deploy lands.

acknowledged.name: crossStraitActivityJapanMod
acknowledged.reason: Japan MOD route returns proxy CONNECT 403; candidate country-specific routes return 407. Second cause independent of the #5689 Decodo exhaustion. No verified replacement endpoint installed.

acknowledged.name: gdeltIntel
acknowledged.reason: GDELT repair route fails TLS (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL). GDELT blocks Railway egress outright, so PROXY_URL is mandatory rather than a fallback, and seed-gdelt-intel is not part of this PR's per-source proxy split. Needs its own tracking issue.

acknowledged.name: humanitarianSummary
acknowledged.reason: HAPI returns 'Blocked due to bot activity' to Railway egress (same signature as #5713, which was closed). Recovers intermittently between health snapshots. Needs its own tracking issue.

acknowledged.name: chinaCoverage
acknowledged.reason: Stale CCFI transport (TRANSPORT_STALE) plus partial official-exchange disclosures (CHINA_COVERAGE_PARTIAL). On-demand key; redundant once the onDemand marker deploys.

acknowledged.name: shippingRates
acknowledged.reason: Two controlled Railway recovery windows produced no container execution. Flaps between polls. On-demand key; redundant once the onDemand marker deploys.
